name: log-viewer
title: Log viewer
description: Windowed log stream (role="log"): level filter, search with highlighted matches, follow-tail and per-line copy. Renders only the visible rows. Optional wrap (default false) shows full messages in measured, variable-height rows; rowHeight estimates unmeasured rows. Optional labels?: Partial<LogViewerLabels> overrides each built-in label, including per-level chip and filter names through labels.levels. Explicit content props win over labels, then I18nProvider (en/es); no provider keeps English. Copied log text and imported fixtures stay unchanged. See the Catalog labels and Full messages and level names live previews.
author: gntik-ai
